intro: Each county election commission runs voting in that county. The Secretary of State's Division of Elections oversees them.

elections.name: General election
elections.hours: Set by each county. Check GoVoteTN for your polling place hours.
elections.what: Federal, state, county, and local offices, plus any measures. Your exact ballot depends on where you live.

dates.label: Last day to register to vote
dates.detail: The deadline is the same online, by mail, or in person.

dates.label: Early voting
dates.detail: Vote early in person. Each county sets its own sites and hours. Find them on GoVoteTN.

src.label: Tennessee Secretary of State: elections calendar

dates.label: Mail ballot request deadline
dates.detail: Your county election commission must receive your written request by this day. You can mail or email it. You must have a reason allowed by law to vote by mail, such as being 60 or older.

src.label: Tennessee Secretary of State: elections calendar
Tennessee Secretary of State: guide to absentee voting

dates.label: Election Day
dates.detail: Vote at your polling place. Mail ballots must reach your county election commission by the time polls close. Ballots must be returned by mail or a delivery service. You can't hand them in.

src.label: Tennessee Secretary of State: guide to absentee voting

id_rule.text: Bring a photo ID to vote early or on Election Day. A Tennessee driver's license, U.S. passport, U.S. military ID, or photo ID from the federal or Tennessee state government works, even if expired. College student IDs and IDs from other states or local governments do not count. Mail voters don't need to show ID.
